sentences.zh: 那是他们当天现场想出来的。

sentences.en: So fun.
sentences.zh: 太有趣了。

sentences.en: It shows the value of having the actor there live,
sentences.zh: 这体现了演员在现场的重要性，

sentences.en: especially on a show like ours that, you know, encouraged improvisation.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在我们这种鼓励即兴表演的剧组里。

sentences.en: And especially between John and Steve, who were so good at this Jim Michael dynamic.
sentences.zh: 特别是约翰和史蒂夫之间，他们太擅长演绎吉姆和迈克尔这种互动关系了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, Dwight overhears Michael talking to Oscar.
sentences.zh: 德怀特无意中听到迈克尔在和奥斯卡谈话。

sentences.en: He's clearly stressing out.
sentences.zh: 他显然压力很大。

sentences.en: And Dwight says, we've got to fix this.
sentences.zh: 德怀特说，我们得解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Michael is broke and living in fear with no friends at a dead-end job.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔破产了，生活在恐惧中，没有朋友，还做着一份没前途的工作。

sentences.en: Yeah, I know.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我知道。

sentences.en: And Andy's kind of like, well, I mean, some of those things were true before today.
sentences.zh: 安迪说，我是说，其中一些情况在今天之前就已经是事实了。

sentences.en: And Dwight's like, not the fear part.
sentences.zh: 德怀特说，恐惧那部分不是。

sentences.en: So they come up with this plan that they're going to convince Michael that Mr. Grotty is
sentences.zh: 于是他们想出了一个计划，要让迈克尔相信格罗蒂先生

sentences.en: not in the mafia, even though, in truth, Andy and Dwight still think he is.
sentences.zh: 并不是黑手党，尽管事实上，安迪和德怀特仍然认为他是。

sentences.en: But they go in and Andy's like, I have a friend who's a fed.
sentences.zh: 他们走进去，安迪说，我有个朋友是联邦探员。

sentences.en: This guy checks out.
sentences.zh: 这家伙没问题。

sentences.en: Dwight says he has a friend on the police force that also clears Grotty's name.
sentences.zh: 德怀特说他有个在警局的朋友也洗清了格罗蒂的嫌疑。

sentences.en: And also cleared the fed just to make sure that he wasn't on the take.
sentences.zh: 甚至还调查了那个联邦探员，以确保他没有受贿。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Steve's performance.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫的表演。

sentences.en: That moment when he, as Michael, thinks he's been lied to.
sentences.zh: 当他饰演的迈克尔意识到自己被骗了的那一刻。

sentences.en: The look that came over his face, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 他脸上露出的那种表情，珍娜。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, Steve is so good.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，噢，史蒂夫演得太好了。

sentences.en: I love every time Steve realizes something as Michael.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢史蒂夫饰演的迈克尔每次恍然大悟的样子。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So Michael says, if there's one thing I hate more than the mafia, it's a liar.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说，如果说有什么比黑手党更让我讨厌的，那就是骗子。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: He's going to call up this guy.
sentences.zh: 他打算给那个人打电话。

sentences.en: Oh, and he gets on the phone and he lays into him and he cancels his policy.
sentences.zh: 噢，他打通了电话，把他痛骂了一顿，还取消了他的保单。

sentences.en: See, everybody is so happy.
sentences.zh: 你看，大家都特别高兴。

sentences.en: And then Dwight and Andy are like, yeah, they tell him what they did.
sentences.zh: 然后德怀特和安迪就说，没错，他们告诉了他他们做的事。

sentences.en: He just stood up to a mobster.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚对抗了一个黑帮分子。

sentences.en: And Michael's like, oh, God, oh, God.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔就说，天哪，天哪。

sentences.en: I should be mad at you guys.
sentences.zh: 我本该生你们气的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Now he just feels like a badass.
sentences.zh: 现在他觉得自己是个硬汉了。

sentences.en: Well, Brent sent in a final audio clip where he explains why he thinks this ending works so well and why he believes it endures.
sentences.zh: 布伦特发来了一段最后的音频片段，解释了他为什么认为这个结局效果这么好，以及为什么他认为它能经久不衰。

sentences.en: I think the Office episode Mafia is an original contribution to the history of comedy
sentences.zh: 我认为《办公室》的这一集《黑手党》是对喜剧史的原创性贡献，

sentences.en: because there is a real story and there's a fake story.
sentences.zh: 因为里面有一个真实的故事，还有一个虚构的故事。

sentences.en: And all of the stakes for the characters happen in the fake story.
sentences.zh: 而角色们所面临的所有风险都发生在那个虚构的故事里。

sentences.en: But the actors grounded and played so real that we actually feel stakes for them
sentences.zh: 但演员们的表演非常扎实、真实，以至于我们真的为他们感到揪心，

sentences.en: and we actually feel their emotional resolution at the end.
sentences.zh: 我们也确实感受到了他们在结尾处的情感宣泄。

sentences.en: It also has an incredibly original ending where Dwight and Andy fake Michael into believing the truth
sentences.zh: 它还有一个极其原创的结局，德怀特和安迪通过欺骗让迈克尔相信了真相，

sentences.en: And this, quote, false understanding of reality is what allows Michael to solve his problems in the fake story.
sentences.zh: 而这种所谓的“对现实的错误理解”，正是迈克尔在虚构故事中解决问题的关键。

sentences.en: It's highly original.
sentences.zh: 这非常有创意。

sentences.en: And I think those scenes of Andy, Dwight, and Michael in Michael's office will stand the test of time with comedy nerds forever.
sentences.zh: 我认为安迪、德怀特和迈克尔在迈克尔办公室里的那些戏份，会永远经受住喜剧迷们的考验。

sentences.en: Well, it stood the test of time for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，它确实经受住了时间的考验。

sentences.en: I loved the complexity of it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它的复杂性。

sentences.en: For sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And, you know, a little piece of Mr. Grotty is going to stay with Michael now.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，格罗蒂先生的一小部分将永远留在迈克尔身上了。

sentences.en: Forever.
sentences.zh: 永远。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，没错。

sentences.zh: 艾琳，我要咖啡，不要厨房里的那种。

sentences.en: If it's not the stop and shop, I send it back.
sentences.zh: 如果不是Stop and Shop的，我就退回去。

sentences.zh: 要大杯的，如果是中杯，我就退回去。

sentences.zh: 如果是超大杯，我也退回去。

sentences.en: So there is part of Michael and Mr. Grotty that are always going to be together.
sentences.zh: 所以迈克尔和格罗蒂先生的一部分将永远连在一起。

sentences.zh: 当迈克尔在办公区吹嘘自己对抗黑帮分子时，

sentences.zh: 镜头非常短暂地扫过他的肩膀，

sentences.zh: 你可以看到墙上换了一幅画，

sentences.zh: 就在原本挂着帕姆水彩画的地方。

sentences.zh: 上面写着“正在清洗”，

sentences.en: and it has stars and smiley faces all around it.
sentences.zh: 周围画满了星星和笑脸。

sentences.en: This is something that Erin put up on the wall.
sentences.zh: 这是艾琳贴在墙上的。

sentences.zh: 在下一集中，

sentences.zh: 那会被换成别的东西，

sentences.zh: 真的吗？
